title: Track work from assignment through integration
statement: As an Architect or Developer coordinating delivery, I can associate specific technical entity identities with a work item's workspace, progress, and merge evidence so contributors and their AI workers can discover their assigned scope and collaborators can track it through integration.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A workspace assignment exposes its portable workspace and repository identities, branch context, role, and whether it is assigned or released.
Recording progress appends a parent-linked state event, and queries expose the history plus a current state only when it has one head.
For each required merge unit, queries expose its lifecycle, and an integrated event identifies both the exact head and merge commit.
A done progress state alone does not satisfy peer-review readiness; immutable delivery evidence is still required.

A work assignment can identify specific System, Component, or data-entity records and their relevant design context, without making the AI worker itself a persona or creating duplicate entity definitions.

A worker can use public queries to retrieve its assigned entity identities, their proposal/implementation state, code evidence, and relevant design links; results distinguish assigned scope from unrelated inventory.

Recording implementation evidence for an assigned entity updates the queryable entity roadmap while preserving assignment and proposal history; entity completion alone does not satisfy required integration or review evidence.
